thought.text: Ada endpoint `/api_keys` dan **`/api_keys/generate_web3_key`** — bisa bikin key via API. Saya baca dokumentasinya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://docs.venice.ai/guides/getting-started/generating-api-key" -o /tmp/g.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; python3 - <<'PY'
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/g.html',errors='ignore').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
i=t.lower().find('api key')
print(t[max(0,i-100):i+1500])
PY
